notes.title: V1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
Dear players, thank you for your support and love. This is the first regular update after the official release. Based on your feedback and suggestions, we have optimized and fixed some game content. The details are as follows:

Idle Mode Functionality
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/79ff2ffbc134b4b1de6724a88e9baa4b6ee12074.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/ded58392f52deb77f69363c88a84ace09a9be6ee.png
Are villagers taking too long to gather resources? Suddenly need to handle other matters? No worries! You can now activate the idle mode function. Combined with the automation feature, villagers can work on their own. All you need to do is monitor their progress!

Quick Villager Selection & Auto Start for the Next Mine Level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/912891ed69dbf020ab1b4a68105f27547dcb8eee.png
Added a one-click quick selection button for villagers. With a single tap, you can send suitable villagers to explore the mine. After the exploration ends, simply click the collect button, and the villagers will automatically proceed to the next mine level.

Camera Movement Speed Adjustment
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/c3336834736e58ebf4a51c56c10c7ec6683120c4.png
Is the camera movement speed not keeping up with your pace? Now, you can adjust it in the in-game settings panel to your preferred speed.

Other Optimizations
1.On the inventory screen, long-pressing the increase or decrease buttons allows quick adjustments to the quantity of items for sale.
2.The game will continue running in the background after being minimized.
3.Automation unlock conditions have been adjusted: the automation feature is now available after unlocking Area 2 instead of through the technology panel.
4.Game values have been adjusted to speed up the game’s pace and reduce its difficulty.

Bug Fixes
1.Fixed an issue with scrolling in the inventory.
2.Fixed a bug where villagers in Area 2 couldn’t work while attacking enemies.
3.Fixed an issue where the game automatically switched to full-screen mode upon returning to the main menu.
4.Fixed a problem where enemies in Area 1 couldn’t be defeated.

notes.title: V1.0.7 Version Update
notes.content:
Dear players,We have made some updates and optimizations to the demo version, including:

Store Function Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/11a8459026a01b8e7f481473705917e9f0688f56.png
A seed store has been added, allowing players to purchase any quantity of seeds at any time and as many times as they like. It’s a must for farming enthusiasts!

Seed Selection Information
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/0d3147447b20934af21d74c707961bb9d4a98b87.png
New information has been added when selecting seeds in the toolbar, making it easier for players to distinguish seed types.

Enemy Level Display
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/defb603bfd6b8265a806be1867fb31c8e25f37c6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/f442b71db00d15937ecd4f234f8739396a7509ee.png
An enemy level display effect has been added.

House Level Display
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/16cccb427e4d8c3e252a58efdbc0261a6c0751bc.png
A house level display effect has been added.

notes.title: V1.0.6 Version Update
notes.content:
Dear players,We have made some updates and optimizations to the demo version, including:

·Mine Gameplay Adjustments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/2b626258320286eca20a02cb3111385253d360f9.png
To focus more on collection, management, and strategy, we have removed the previous complex mine gameplay. The mine is now set to an idle mode, making resource collection easier and gameplay more intuitive so you can better enjoy life on the island.

·Feature Unlocks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/0960ff36223a2083b50fdc164ac307fc8d1b6494.png
Now, when you enter the game, you won’t be overwhelmed by too many unknown features and mechanics. As you unlock different areas step by step, features and gameplay will gradually become available.

·Upgrade Technology (Full Version Feature)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/1df3d27633469401125d30dbcf29d0d92db18a19.png
Are villagers moving too slowly? Are resource drops too low? Don’t worry! You can address these issues by upgrading technology!

·Automated Work (Full Version Feature)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177132/5b2fab999413756b15a4016ba68e70ebf97ed5d2.png
By unlocking the corresponding technology, you can enable automated work, freeing your hands and allowing you to focus more on taking care of your villagers!
